progressCheckpoint: Implemented the C.5-confirmed paragraph/small direct-link plus adjacent generated parenthesized metadata rule. Target compares improved and runtime/unit checks passed. Full corpus still has two protected fixture failures, but a clean HEAD archive reproduced the same Microsoft and Sky mismatches, so they are recorded as pre-existing, not patch regressions.

engineChanges.summary: Added a guarded paragraph/small fragmenter for direct visible links followed by generated before/after parenthesized metadata, preserving link-first VoiceOver order and joining following plain metadata text.
Stopped descent into paragraphs handled by the new metadata fragmenter to avoid duplicate link/text stops.
Added focused coverage for non-PDF link metadata, hidden controlled rows, generated parentheses, and emphasis boundaries after metadata.
Rebuilt the packaged extension runtime from the accepted engine change.

narrowingGuards: Only p and small containers are eligible.
The container must not have role, aria-label, aria-labelledby, an interactive ancestor, a listitem ancestor, or an expanded controlled-region relationship.
The metadata element must be non-interactive, unnamed by ARIA, visible, short, direct, and expose literal generated before '(' and after ')' text.
Hidden and aria-hidden descendants remain skipped.
The rule does not inspect hrefs, file extensions, URLs, Royal Mail text, classes, or site-specific copy.

targetCompareDelta.fixedShape: Terms PDF row now emits link first, then parenthesized metadata/date text, then the emphasized note as a separate stop.

Latest First and download rows now emit link-first stops followed by generated parenthesized metadata. The remaining latest-first difference is the audit-excluded OCR spacing artifact before Thursday.
